summary: Sprint 11B (Portal Cliente - Profile Hardening) end-to-end tested. Backend pytest test_phase11b_profile.py: 11/11 PASS — covers extended profile GET/PATCH shape + bad-tz rejection, avatar upload/delete + 413 oversize, full MFA cycle (setup→verify with live pyotp code→10 backup codes XXXX-XXXX→disable via backup), MFA bad-code 401, sessions list with is_current + self-revoke causing 401, revoke-others keeping current, notifications PATCH persistence, deletion request email-mismatch 400 + matching success + cancel. Frontend /client/profile loads all 5 tabs (profile-tab-account/security/sessions/notifications/danger) reachable from sidebar nav-perfil. Cuenta tab: editing full_name enables profile-save which PATCHes successfully and toast 'Datos guardados' appears (verified field persists). Seguridad tab: mfa-enable-btn opens scan step (mfa-qr , mfa-secret-manual, mfa-cancel, mfa-scan-continue), entering live pyotp code reveals mfa-backup-codes block with backup-code-0..9 (all 10 visible as XXXX-XXXX), backup-copy + backup-download + backup-done buttons. Profile flips to MFA ACTIVO. Sesiones tab: each row has session-{id} + session-revoke-{id} testids; current session is text-tagged 'Esta sesión' and shows 'Cerrar y salir' (full revoke-self) while non-current rows show plain 'Cerrar'. Notificaciones tab: 6 toggle testids (notif-email_security_alerts, notif-email_account_activity, notif-email_yield_summary, notif-email_marketing, notif-inapp_alerts, notif-inapp_transactions) + notifications-save. Eliminar cuenta tab: request-deletion-btn opens deletion-modal (deletion-confirm-email + deletion-reason + deletion-cancel + deletion-confirm); submitting with matching email transitions to pending state.

missing_data_testids.note: Current session is communicated only via the visible text 'Esta sesión' and the longer button label 'Cerrar y salir' (vs plain 'Cerrar' on others). A dedicated data-testid (e.g. session-current-badge on the row or session-revoke-current-btn) would simplify E2E assertions. Functionality is correct.
Cleanup-test selectors during verify-step relied on input[inputmode=numeric]. Adding testids would harden the playbook.

console_warnings.observation: Same generic 403 'Failed to load resource' noise on every /client/* page noted since iteration_13. Unchanged in 11B.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid 'session-current-badge' (or similar) on the current session row in SessionsTab to avoid relying on text 'Esta sesión'.
(Optional) Add data-testid 'mfa-code-input' and 'mfa-verify-submit' on the MFA verify step in SecurityTab.
(Pre-existing, low) Investigate the 3-6 generic 403 console errors emitted on every /client/* page — present since iteration_13, not introduced by 11B.
critical_code_review_comments: client_profile.py (~512 lines) is well under the 700-line threshold but already covers 4 concerns (profile/avatar/MFA/sessions/notifications/deletion). When Sprint 12 adds more, consider splitting into client_mfa.py + client_sessions.py + client_account.py.

TIMEZONES_WHITELIST in client_profile.py is a hard-coded tuple of 12 zones. Frontend timezone dropdown must stay in sync — currently no shared constant. Consider exposing GET /v1/client/profile/timezones or moving the list to a shared schemas module.

/v1/client/avatar accepts any data:image/* MIME via prefix check but does not validate the actual decoded bytes are a real PNG/JPEG (no magic-byte sniff). A user could store data:image/png;base64,<arbitrary base64 ≤256KB>. Low risk (the URL is only ever echoed back to the same user) but worth a Pillow validation.

_consume_backup uses $pull on the bcrypt hash list — correct, but bcrypt verifies are sequential (10 codes × ~50ms = 500ms worst case). Acceptable for /disable but consider indexing by code prefix if scaled.

request_deletion writes deletion_effective_at as ISO string at request time. A background job to actually disable the user after 7 days is NOT yet present (audit log only). Confirm ops process is wired before promoting to prod, and add a daily cron that flips users with deletion_effective_at < now() to status='deleted'.

_qr_data_url uses fill_color='#0B0F19' on white — fine for light theme but contrast may be reduced on dark theme (the image is a PNG so it doesn't react to theme). Consider rendering with theme-aware colors or adding a white background card around the .
test_credentials: client.admin@finpact.io and client.admin@alemany.capital via GET /api/v1/auth/dev-login?email=...&next=/client/profile. MFA_FERNET_KEY confirmed present in /app/backend/.env. pyotp used to compute live TOTP codes during frontend MFA verify.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 11B is solid: 11/11 backend pytest + all 5 frontend tabs verified with live integrations (MFA enroll + verify + backup codes + disable, account deletion request modal, notifications toggle group, sessions list with current indicator, avatar upload buttons, profile PATCH with toast). Two minor testid gaps documented (Sessions current-badge, MFA verify step inputs).
